title: Combat · Command menu and ánimas
description: The battle menu: Atacar, Habilidad, ?????, Defender and Huir, under the fighter's vitals plate and ánima bar (one segment per ánima, never wrapping: up to four share it, names shrinking to fit), flanked by Q and E (L and R on a controller), which swap the active fighter's ánima: the menu sweeps, the face lights up, the theme and the skills change. Habilidad opens its skills sideways; △ / Y (I on the keyboard) shows a skill's cost and description beside it. Bernat wears no ánima and has no skills.

steps.caption: Gerard wears Noísta: Q · Matemágico · Noísta · E under his plate

steps.eval: window.extraAnimas = [['Papagato', '#7fc8d8'], ['Cuarta ánima', '#9bd27a']].map(([name, colour]) => { const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.tabIndex = -1; b.textContent = name; b.style.setProperty('--chip', colour); return b; }); window.extraAnimas.slice(0, 1).forEach(b => document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"] .anima-chips').append(b));
